comments.c1: I can't believe they actually killed Paul in the third act, did not see that coming
comments.c2: The score in this trailer is incredible, Zimmer never misses
comments.c3: Book readers know Chani leaves him at the end and honestly the movie should keep that
comments.c4: Who else is watching this for the 10th time
comments.c5: Anyone know when tickets go on sale?
comments.c6: So the twist is that Alia is the one who stabs the Baron, they finally showed it
comments.c7: This looks worse than part two ngl
comments.c8: Bro spoiler alert: sandworms are in it
